title: Price Type and Bonus Event Points on a Late Credit — Finch Circle Loyalty Program Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the price-type event share is none (0) when the claimed unit was bought at a doorbuster or final sale price, one half (0.5) when it was bought at a clearance price, and the whole (1) at any other price.

The price type is the one shown on the claimed unit's purchase record under Merchandise Purchases.

| Price type of the claimed unit | Price-type event share |
|---|---|
| Doorbuster | 0 |
| Final sale | 0 |
| Clearance | 0.5 |
| Any other price | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A coffee maker bought at a doorbuster price: share 0.
- A winter coat bought at a clearance price: share one half.
- A sweater bought at its regular price: share the whole.
